title: Can be used for more than Ziplock bags but I’m not crazy about the design; cannot be hung - 2.5 *
text:
Can be used for more than Ziplock bags but I’m not crazy about the design; cannot be hung - 2.5 *. I am not crazy about the design of this Ziplock bag organizer that comes in four separate compartments with one each for quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack bags. Since this is not one unit, it cannot be hung on the wall. There are NO felt feet on the underside of the boxes for when it is placed on the counter or in a drawer. The beauty of a design like this is that each compartment can be configured anyway one desires. They can go in several separate drawers or in an L shape in one drawer, or side-by-side, etc.

Unfortunately, the design is not what I like. First of all, I can easily load the bags through the large opening but it is designed for the bottom to slide out. This means if I turn over the compartment to load the bags from the bottom, the bags start to fall out of the top. In addition, the bottoms on two of the organizers are so loosely seated, it slides off if I am not careful when I pick up the compartment. What I do like is that they supply labels that I can either choose to use or not. Since the compartments are unlabeled, they can be used to organize socks, hold garlic, etc. Nevertheless, if I use this to hold garlic or onions, the sliding bottom is a problem.

Personally, this set is mediocre. No wonder it is so cheap at $17.99. Even though I love the way this keeps all my plastic bags in order, it is not my favorite due to the sliding bottom. Now if the bottom on two of the units did not slide off so easily, then I would have rated this 4 stars. Other options that are available for organizers like this are this [[ASIN:B09D5Y63D1 one]] if one is looking for four separate compartments. For a variety of organizers (separate and one unit), then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. For a more modern look, I recommend this [[ASIN:B09WN5PZ6Q one]]. For a larger unit that has room for foil and plastic wrap, then I highly recommend this [[ASIN:B0B1TPD21S one]]. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires. I personally like these other ones a little better than this one.

product_metadata.title: Bamboo Ziplock Bag Storage Organizer, KAQINWX Food Storage Bag Organizer for Kitchen Drawer with 21 Label Stickers & Removable Back, Suitable for Gallon, Quart & Snack Variety Size Bag
features: 【Ziplock Bag Storage Organizer】KAQINWX ziplock food storage bag organizers fit perfectly for gallon, quart, sandwich and snack storage bags. It's compatible with Ziploc, Solimo, Hefty, Glad, Great Value and other brands. DO NOT WORK WITH QUART SLIDER BAGS.

【Customized Labels Provided】21 labels provided helps you identify drawer contents immediately. You can label each ziplock bag organizer or unlabel them to maintain the clean appearance of the food storage bag holder.
【Environmental-friendly Material】These ziplock bag storage organizers are made of durable and sustainable environmental-friendly bamboo, which is healthy and safe for your daily life.

【Unique Slidable Bottom Design】With wipe opening and slidable bottom design, you can easily put baggies in and remove them quickly. No assembling required. Just put food storage bags in and start storing them neatly and efficiently with our bamboo ziplock bag organizer.

【Food Storage Bag Organizer Set】KAQINWX ziplock bag dispenser organizer comes with 4 boxes of 2 sizes (12.2"*4.8"*3" for Gallon, 8.2"*3"*3" for Sandwich, Quart and Snack.) Independent boxes offer you mutiple combinations to keep your food storage bags in order and neat. Ideal ziplock bag organizer for drawers, cabinets, storage shelves according to your needs.
